entities.summary: Hanne Vandewinkel is a Belgian professional tennis player. She has career-high rankings of world No. 104 in singles, achieved on 16 March 2026, and No. 444 in doubles, reached in February 2024. Vandewinkel has won one WTA 125 singles title as well as nine singles and three doubles titles on the ITF Circuit.
